legs.rationale: Panama have failed to score in either group match and are missing their key creative midfielder Carrasquilla; the model assigns only 15% to both teams scoring, well above the market's implied 29% for BTTS yes, making BTTS no at 1.33 a clear positive-expectation play.

slips.rationale: Panama are scoreless in two group games and eliminated with no attacking incentive; BTTS no carries +0.098 edge against a market that underestimates England's ability to keep a clean sheet against the tournament's most toothless attack.
